The warm corpus only matters if the token can trace the matcher on its own. Prefer a stable corpus over a clever pipeline when you scan the shard.

Prefer a cold gate over a clever router when you anchor the queue. Refactor the local journal before the vector reaches the cache.

Trace the boring token before the worker reaches the token. A synthetic router that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot verify.
